responsibility: Defines GCC’s primary AVX-512VL intrinsic header, which adapts baseline AVX-512 masking semantics to 128-bit and 256-bit SSE/AVX vector widths. It introduces the common VL mask type aliases and a large set of masked move/load/store, blend, compare, and conversion helpers for __m128/__m128i/__m128d and __m256/__m256i/__m256d, acting as the core narrow-width companion to avx512fintrin.h.
